'''Cleopatra Island'''  (Japanese: '''クレオパトラ島''' ''Cleopatra Island'') is an island in the [[Orange Islands]].

It appeared in ''[[EP105|Charizard Chills]]''. [[Tad]] challenged {{Ash}} to a {{pkmn|battle}} with his {{p|Poliwrath}}. After it defeated {{AP|Pikachu}}, it then {{status|froze}} {{AP|Charizard}}. Fearing for its life, Ash stayed up all night with his Pokémon, making sure Charizard would be okay. After Charizard recovered, Ash had a [[rematch]] with Tad and proved victorious.

Although Cleopatra Island is large, only the beach was shown.
